label: Blind sample burn null 002: tree-covered land >= 5 km from any MTBS perimeter, near VA

verdict.headline: No real change
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) rose by 0.03 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 14 Nov 2019 (90% interval −0.00 to +0.07). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 11 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.20). Counted by gap size instead, 9 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.16). The interval rules out a meaningful change beyond what the controls did.
reasons: a change of at least 0.05 in burn ratio (NBR) is ruled out by the interval

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
